note: ABBA - I Have a Dream, first minute (0-55 s). The analysis reports 104 BPM, but the real pulse is ~52 BPM (the human caught the double): 1 real beat = 2 detected beats, 1 bar = 8. step_beats maps each movement onto real beats and bars. Choreographed by Claude; concert phone-wave idea from the human.

segments.note: soft intro: rise over half a bar, settle over the other
gentle nods: down on one real beat, up on the next
end of intro: small hello, one side per half bar
verse 1 from 13.3 s: phone in the air, one side per bar
after the 31.7 s lift: lower sway, one side per half bar
build: higher and wider, one side per bar
energy lifts at 50 s: one slow breath (rise half a bar, settle half a bar) back to ready
